activity.notes: Alboin was king of the Lombards from about 565 until his death in 572 and led the Lombard invasion of Italy beginning in 568. ATLAS therefore marks the accession boundary approximate while keeping 572 as the conventional terminal year, reusing the existing Kingdom of the Lombards polity.

sources.citation_text: Britannica identifies Alboin as king of the Lombards about 565–572 and leader of the 568–569 invasion of Italy.

sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Alboin as king of the Germanic Lombards who conquered northern Italy and died in 572.
